description.value: Boston Pizza is a well-known Canadian casual dining chain and sports bar, founded in Edmonton in 1964 and now the largest casual dining brand in Canada. This Nanaimo franchise location serves the full BP menu including gourmet pizzas, pasta, wings, burgers, and shareables. Touring cyclists will find a substantial sit-down meal with a wide range of dietary options including vegan and gluten-free choices, plus takeout and delivery available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Nanaimo location at 2-5779 Turner Road with phone (250) 751-0090, matching OSM. The menu page explicitly states 'Vegan and Glutenwise® options also available' and the nutrition page confirms gluten-free, vegetarian options. Takeout/delivery is confirmed by the ORDER NOW functionality and separate delivery phone number listed. No bike-related amenities, Wi-Fi, or washroom mentions appear anywhere in the website content, so those remain null per evidence rules.
concerns: OSM top-level address omits unit number; website shows '2-5779 Turner Road' — OSM addr:unit=2 tag captures this but the combined address field in OSM data is incomplete.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A full-service sit-down restaurant with takeout and a broad menu including vegetarian and GF options; a reliable and well-known food stop for touring cyclists passing through Nanaimo.
